name: Brittany Haynes

five_sec.what_is_it: Some kind of meal planning thing with a video of a mom and her little girl laughing in the kitchen
five_sec.trust_why: Honestly it looks like a real company and all, but the top just says Less Stress More Dinners and a video, so I don't know what I'm getting
five_sec.next_step: Scroll down and look for Walmart and something that says family size
five_sec.delivers_food_why: Nothing on that first screen says if they mail you food or just give you recipes

full_page.what_stopped_me: I did see the big Walmart logo and a Kid Friendly and Budget Friendly plan, which, yes, but then the pictures are like shrimp po'boys and plum watercress salad and Cody is not making that, and I never found a price
full_page.whats_missing: A price, portions for 6, and some way to send the plan to my husband

EM.quote: Walmart logo, great, Kid Friendly plan, great, but y'all show me Plum-Watercress Salad and Cody's gonna order a pizza before he finds a plum

five_sec.what_is_it: HelloFresh, the boxes, and a little game where you pick a box
five_sec.who_for: People with a lot more money than a family of six on one-and-a-half paychecks
five_sec.trust_why: Everybody's heard of them but the pick-a-box thing feels like a carnival game
five_sec.next_step: Look for how much it'd be for six of us
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It's HelloFresh, they ship you the food in those green boxes right on the screen

full_page.what_stopped_me: Couldn't get a price without putting in my zip, and the fine print is a whole paragraph. For six people that's gonna be more than our whole grocery budget

HF.quote: Their smallest box is meals for two people and I've got six mouths, honestly I didn't even need the zip code to know that's not happening

five_sec.what_is_it: An app that figures out dinner for you, with little notifications popping up on the phone
five_sec.trust_why: 90,000 families is a lot, but the only button is a letter from the CEO and I don't know who that is
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It's a phone with a menu on it, looks like recipes

full_page.what_stopped_me: It does Walmart and the paid one covers the whole family group chat, which is kinda what I want for Cody, but it's $25 a month and you count messages, no ma'am
full_page.whats_missing: A normal price and dinners you can actually see before you start

OL.quote: 'One subscription covers your whole family group chat' got me excited until I saw $25 a month, that's two pizzas, honestly

five_sec.what_is_it: A recipe and grocery list app, people writing in planners
five_sec.who_for: Organized ladies who save recipes off Pinterest
five_sec.trust_why: 4.8 stars and it says no card right on it
five_sec.next_step: See if it'll just give me a plan
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It says recipes and grocery lists

full_page.what_stopped_me: I'd have to find all the recipes myself and plan it on my 15-minute break, which is the whole problem
full_page.whats_missing: Somebody picking supper for us, and something Cody can follow

PTE.quote: It's nice it says no card and 4.8 stars, but 'Save Recipes While You Scroll' means I'm still the one doing all of it

five_sec.what_is_it: It texts everybody in the house the dinner ideas and then puts the grocery list in your Walmart cart
five_sec.who_for: Families like mine where somebody else has to cook some nights
five_sec.trust_why: No card needed and it plainly says they don't deliver food, I like plain. Never heard of them though
five_sec.next_step: See a sample week and see if it's normal food
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It says right there in green, 'We don't deliver food'

full_page.what_stopped_me: The sample week is for a family of four at $64, so I'm doing math for six in my head, and the texting part is the Family plan you pay for after 14 days
full_page.whats_missing: A big-family sample and a look at the text Cody would get on a cook night

DD.quote: Texts reminders on cook nights and tacos, meatballs, English muffin pizzas from Walmart? Honestly Cody could do that, and $4.99 is less than one pizza night

dd_offer.why: It says it a bunch of times, Family free for 14 days, no card, and if you don't add a card you go back to the free one
dd_offer.expect_day_15: The texting stuff stops unless I pay the $4.99, and the regular planning and Walmart part stays free

head_to_head.reason: It's the only one that texts the plan to Cody and fills my Walmart cart without costing more than a pizza

EM.reason: Both do Walmart, but DinnerDrop texts the whole house and I can see the price

PTE.reason: DinnerDrop picks supper, Plan to Eat makes me do it

OL.reason: Same texting idea for $4.99 instead of $25

HF.reason: Six people on Walmart groceries beats six people on meal kits

dd_fix_that_would_move_me: Home page sample week: add a family-of-6 tab with its Walmart total, and show the actual cook-night text the other parent gets.
